Resource management plays a key role in reducing global challenges such as energy poverty, malnutrition, and air and water pollution. Resource depletion happens when resources are used faster than nature can replace them. Managing water, energy, soil, and ecosystems helps ensure reliable electricity, nutritious food, and cleaner environments.
